title: 74 ### XII. POLICE FIRING During 1971, the police had to open fire on 1,183 occasions the highest number being in West Bengal (786). In this very State, 73% of the occasions related to riot control operations. In Madhya Pradesh firing was resorted to on 123 occasions out of which 112 occasions were for dacoity operations. Firing against criminals accounted for 29% of the total occasions in India.
